records.name: GopherHole
records.tagline: Your AI assistant just made a friend
records.description: Your friend has an AI assistant. You have one too. What if they could talk to each other? GopherHole is a hub where AI agents connect and collaborate — built on the open A2A standard. 🔍 Discover — Find agents by capability 🤝 Connect — Approve once, they work together forever 💬 Collaborate — Agents help each other autonomously 💰 Earn — Monetize your agent's skills Works with Claude, NemoClaw, OpenClaw or your own. SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go. Free to use and enjoy.

records.name: VaultDB
records.tagline: Automated database backups/restore with 1-click
records.description: VaultDB is a SaaS platform that automates database backups for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and MariaDB — so developers and teams never lose critical data again. Most teams rely on manual scripts, cron jobs, or hope. VaultDB replaces all of that with a simple dashboard where you connect your database, set a schedule, and let it run automatically. Backups are stored securely in S3-compatible storage, versioned, and ready to restore with a single click — anytime, from any device.

records.name: CarfaxCheaper
records.tagline: Official Carfax reports for $5.99. Cheap Carfax Reports
records.description: Why pay $39.99 for a single Carfax report when you get the exact same official report for $5.99? CarfaxCheaper delivers the same vehicle history data as Carfax.com accident records, title history, and everything else. Enter your VIN, pay $5.99, get your report in under 60 seconds.

records.name: ILAHB
records.tagline: All-in-one app to manage your football academy
records.description: ILAHB replaces paper attendance sheets, WhatsApp groups, and spreadsheets with one simple app for football academies and clubs. Core features: • One-tap digital attendance - mark players present in seconds • Team convocations with shareable RSVP links • Calendar for training sessions and matches • Player profiles and group management Built as a Progressive Web App — works on any phone, installs from the browser, no app store needed.

records.name: Note Nexus
records.tagline: Everything a BTech student needs - in one place
records.description: Note Nexus is a centralised platform for BTech students to access notes, opportunities, and learning resources without wasting hours searching across the internet. Instead of jumping between 10 different sites, students can find everything in one place – structured, simple, and easy to use. Built by a student who faced the same struggle.

records.name: Muslim Coin
records.tagline: Global blockchain ecosystem for ethical digital finance
records.description: Muslim Coin (MSLM) is a next-generation cryptocurrency project powering a global blockchain ecosystem. Built to support secure transactions, decentralized applications, and digital asset innovation, Muslim Coin aims to expand access to Web3 technologies worldwide. The platform focuses on transparency, community growth, and real-world blockchain adoption, providing tools and infrastructure for developers, investors, and users in the evolving digital economy.

records.name: Doodles Ai
records.tagline: An artist platform using a self-contained Doodles IP LLM
records.description: Doodles AI is a first-of-its-kind, artist-led AI platform under which sits Prism 1.0, a closed-loop model trained exclusively on Doodles IP. The model allows anyone to generate studio-grade images interpreted through Doodles iconic lens in seconds, without style theft or third-party IP infringement. For Doodles and their brand partners, it's an always-on UGC engine. Every generation is empowering your audience to create beautiful co-branded visuals at scale.

records.name: Nano Banana Pro
records.tagline: Master AI Image Generation with Google Nano Banana Models
records.description: Users can leverage Nano Banana 2.5 Flash and Pro models to create photorealistic portraits, cinematic scenes, and high-resolution 4K designs with superior text rendering. Whether you're a designer, content creator, or AI enthusiast, Nano Banana Pro empowers you to bring your creative visions to life with unmatched quality and control. Try it free at bananapro.dev!

records.name: Pinpoint
records.tagline: From production bug to Linear ticket in 2 seconds
records.description: Pinpoint is a Chrome extension that lets you annotate any webpage and instantly create Linear tickets with full context. Click elements, drag areas, or select text — Pinpoint captures screenshots, DOM paths, and React component chains automatically. One click sends everything to Linear: screenshots embedded, metadata attached, ready for your team or AI agents to pick up. No account needed. Free. → 3 annotation modes → Screenshots per annotation → React tree + DOM selector detection → OAuth 2.0

records.name: RegimeForecast
records.tagline: Know the market regime before you trade
records.description: Most trading strategies fail not from bad entries, but from running in the wrong market environment. RegimeForecast uses AI and Hidden Markov Models to classify the current market regime in real-time: trending, mean-reverting, or high-volatility. Get regime dashboards, alerts on regime changes, historical backtesting, and an API. Built for systematic traders, quant funds, and prop desks who want to adapt to market conditions instead of running static models that quietly bleed out.
